# Off Topic - Bring out Another K

Damn, just when things were putting along nicely.

Main motor lower unit oil comes out milky. 😔

Skimmer transducer is busted up on the bottom. 🤬

Not the finish for 2026 I was looking for. 😳🫤🤕🤬🌻

 

That sucks. But at least caught to water in the lower unit before it froze and split the case.

 

Yeah, I'll give you that one [@done working](https://www.longpoint.on.ca/members/6382/) I always change oil before storing but now I have to get the seals replaced when almost everyone else is is using shops to do what I do myself.

Going to be interesting who can fit it in their schedule.

That Totalscan transducer is $460, I have some thinking to do. 🫤🤔😔🌻

It is likely not leaking too bad when sitting still so the oil should not all run out, especially if the motor it trimmed up a bit.

# Fishing Report - Can't go Friday but......

So I was reminded we have plans on Friday, so I can't go fishin. BUT.........I didn't have anything in particular planned for today other than payin bills, so I dropped my wife off at 5:40am for her shift then headed to the pier again just because I NEVER go this late in the season and I have a friend who keeps telling me how many fish he was catching this time of the year off the pier last year, so I figured, why not. 🤷‍♂️

Got to the pier at 6:30am and then sat there for an hour waiting for it to get light out because someone left his friggin headlamp and flashlight on the kitchen table this morning where it did him all kinds of good when he got to the pier in the dark this morning. Couldn't see a damn thing. Once it was light enough to see tho, put my rain gear on to break the wind and headed out to 'my spot,' set up my chair, put some water in my bait pail.

I had worms with me, but put the minnow net together and started trying to catch some bait. Did that for an hour before I even put my fishin rod together. Put a worm on the bottom hook, minnow on the other two and finally got my line in the water about 8:40ish. Then continued catching minnows. I got lots again. I got my first bite around 9:30, missed it. Checked, took the worm off the bottom hook. Put a minnow on it instead and put it back. Got another bigger hit......missed it......checked, nothing missing, put it back out, kept tryin for bait. This entire time, I was all by myself. ![:nailbiting:](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7 "Nail Biting    :nailbiting:")

Then someone named Bob came out to visit with me. Said he knew it was me because he reads my reports. Hi Bob.👋 🤣 Then I decided since I wasn't havin much luck in 'my spot' where the water was pretty flat due to the protection the pier gives, I moved to the east side of the pier where there was a nice chop from the east wind and dropped my line in there and within a couple minutes, a bite. One and done. Then I caught a sheephead that Bob was kind enough to help me land with my net. Put it back in the water on the other side, replaced the minnow, and put my line back in and maybe 10 minutes later, hooked into something again. Wasn't very big, or didn't feel like it was, and it was NOT a sheephead, but I dunno what it was because it spit the hook before I could see it, and sheephead NEVER spit the hook.😉  
Checked the bait, put it back and again about 10 minutes later, maybe, a barely noticable bite, but I noticed and set the hook...........Bob asked if I wanted him to net it for me and initially I wasn't sure, but then I saw it.......and the answer was YES PLEASE!!!.............WALLEYE!!!!.........4lbs. (I weighed it before I slit its throat about an hour later.) Thanks for the assist Bob. 😁All totaled this year that now makes 75 walleye that came home with me throughout the season. 32 given to me, 57 I caught myself, 25 of those off pier. Well over 200 caught off that pier that I know of because I saw them this year.😯

Didn't get another bite after that and called it a day at 1:30pm since I had other things like payin some bills that had to be taken care of before I picked my wife up at 4. Came home, cleaned that walleye, gave half to one neighbor, the other half to another. Considering they KNOW I'm in hibernation by now, they were thrilled I brought them each half of a fish that was caught today. Sorry no photos today, but you all know what a farm animal looks like, and you all know what a walleye looks like no matter what you call it. (Lunch works) I was a little busy trying to get things done before I had to go pick my wife up at 4. Just barely made it 🤣

As I said the other day, there are a couple people who can get me to come out of hibernation, and they know who they are, but with my birthday coming up in a little over a week, and the fact that I've already been out twice within the last week when I NEVER go at this time of year unless one of those I mentioned who can get me to come out, gets in touch with me askin if I wanna go, I don't think it likely I'll be going to the pier again this year, so I'm hibernating now. Have a good winter everyone.
